Step 5

Google Business Profile post

Google Search your outlet name → Add update → upload the image → paste the text → add a button. Never type phone numbers, links or hashtags in the text: Google removes those posts.

Post text
Supplement advice from a pharmacist in Taman Johor Jaya: we open at 8:30AM daily, right after the morning market. Alpro Pharmacy Taman Johor Jaya, No. 19, Jalan Dedap 13, open 8:30AM to 9PM every day. Taking vitamins or herbal products alongside your clinic medicines? Our pharmacist suggests three easy steps. First, take a photo of the back label of every vitamin, supplement and herbal product at home. Second, keep those photos together in one album on your phone, so nobody needs to remember names. Third, bring that album and your clinic medicines in their original packets to the counter, all at one visit. We go through everything side by side, talk about timing where it helps, and tell you what is worth mentioning to your doctor. Your doctor's plan always comes first. Walk in, no appointment needed.

正文 Note
在新山柔佛再也的药房，常常有安娣早上逛完巴刹顺路来问：家里的维他命、鱼油、草药补品，和诊所拿的药，可以一起吃吗？🤔 我们的药剂师Chloe教大家三个小步骤： 1️⃣ 把家里每一瓶保健品背面的标签都拍下来 2️⃣ 全部放进同一个手机相册，不用记品牌名字 3️⃣ 下次带着这个相册和诊所的药（原包装）一起来，一次看完 药剂师会帮你一起对照，看看哪些最好分开时间吃，哪些可以在下次复诊时问医生。医生给的计划永远放第一。💙 小提醒：偶尔才吃的冲剂、朋友送的补品也要拍哦！ 📍 Alpro Pharmacy Taman Johor Jaya（柔佛再也） No. 19, Jalan Dedap 13, Taman Johor Jaya, 81100 Johor Bahru 🕣 每天上午8:30至晚上9:00 欢迎直接到店问药剂师，无需预约。
